kyoto_kuzushi_kotowari.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the course uses house-made soy sauces, tempura (hamo, soft roe) and a foie-gras sushi with a ginger-pork style sauce (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kuzushi_kotowari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and meat course on dashi from bonito, vegetables and fish (official site).
kyoto_kuzushi_kotowari.hours_raw: Tabelog: Thu–Tue and holidays 18:00–22:30; closed Wednesday and the last day of each month, plus irregular days. One course a night, ¥8,800 tax included, starting together at 18:00 (official site; December 2024); foie-gras sushi ¥800 extra (Tabelog). A ¥300 charge applies if no drink is ordered (Tabelog; Japanese original 「ドリンクのご注文がない場合は、チャージ料として300円(税込)頂戴いたします。」). Bookings by phone or TableCheck (official site). 16 seats: 10 at the counter, a tatami room upstairs for up to 6; non-smoking; children welcome if counted for the adult course; please avoid strong perfume (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay. Opened 1 October 2021 (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_kuzushi_kotowari.notes: [Creative kappo · Shijo-Gojo, one course at six] A ten-seat counter that sets out to "break down" stiff kappo: one ¥8,800 monthly course at 18:00, mixing Japanese technique with Western touches — sashimi with house vegetable soy sauces, hamo tempura with green-plum purée, guji rice — plus the much-ordered foie-gras sushi. Diners call it remarkable value and the service relaxed. ¥300 charge without a drink; no strong perfume. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef from Mie (official site: 生まれ故郷である三重); not named. A July 2025 diner found it run by three men.
chef_bio.origin: Mie Prefecture, per the official site (「生まれ故郷である三重産をはじめ」).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in October 2021 near Gojo Station aiming to be an everyday kappo, breaking down the formal image of kappo in both mood and food for younger diners; one reasonably priced ¥8,800 course; traditional Japanese technique with Western elements; the name’s 理 recalls 北大路魯山人’s saying that cooking is measuring the principle of things; ingredients from the owner’s home of Mie and from Kyoto (vegetables, hamo, ayu); dashi from bonito, vegetables and fish used by dish; house-made soy sauces blended with seasonal vegetable sauces; antique and contemporary tableware chosen by season.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 崩しつつも細部まで妥協しない本格和食 — breaking down the stiffness of kappo while never compromising on detail.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly ¥8,800 course; foie-gras sushi; house vegetable soy sauces.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 guest who arrived early found the owner hanging the noren and was invited in; by 18:00 nine guests had arrived for the single seating.
"Given the quality, it felt a bit too affordable, which made me a little worried." — January 2025.
A November 2026 regular on a third visit wondered whether the sudachi and crab on the sesame tofu were really needed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kuzushi-kotowari.com): くずし理 (くずしことわり)、日常使いのできる割烹を目指し2021年10月に五条駅近くに開店、割烹の格式高く堅苦しいイメージを雰囲気と料理の両面から崩したい、若い人にも気軽に、お品書きは8,800円のディナーコース一つ、伝統的な日本料理の技法に洋食の要素、店名の「理」は北大路魯山人の「料理とは、理を料ること」から、毎月変わるコース、生まれ故郷である三重産をはじめ京野菜、ハモ、鮎、出汁は鰹や野菜や魚から、造りや前菜の手作り醤油に野菜のソース、骨董と現代作家の器、先付 (ハモの天ぷらと青梅のすり流し)、前菜5種、椀 (あさり出汁のアスパラとイサキ、トリュフオイル)、造り (ヒラメに焼きとうもろこし醤油)、くずし (賀茂茄子の田楽に焼き鮎の餡)、酢の物 (アコウの昆布締め)、2025年12月30日〜2026年1月7日は年末年始休み、TableCheck で予約。食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮、下京区万寿寺通堺町東入俵屋町239-2、木〜火・祝 18:00〜22:30、水曜と毎月末日休み、不定休、ドリンクの注文がない場合はチャージ料300円 (税込)、16席 (カウンター10、座敷6)、禁煙、子供は大人と同じコースなら可、香水など強い香りは控えて、カード・PayPay 可、追加のフォアグラ寿司800円、2021年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 18時一斉スタート、8,800円のコース、フォアグラの握り、酢のジュレ、鯛と春菊と柚子のたれ、白子の天ぷら、ぐじのご飯、桜海老の餅と白味噌、冷たい出汁茶漬け、男性3人で営む、値段の割に安すぎて心配になるほど。

cultural_comfort.note: One course at a single 18:00 start, each dish explained (September 2026); book ahead; avoid strong perfume.

kyoto_la_risotteria_daimaru.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options and risotto is rice-based, but pasta, pizza and bread are also served; no detail on how (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_la_risotteria_daimaru.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the signature risotto alla milanese comes with ossobuco and most risotti use stock and cheese (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_la_risotteria_daimaru.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00, café 15:00–17:00, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closing days follow Daimaru Kyoto (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Happy hour with ¥500 drinks (July 2026). 32 seats incl. sofa seats and a counter; English and Simplified Chinese menus with photos; children welcome with kids' menu; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking, smoking area on the floor; cards and QR (Tabelog). On the 8th floor of the Daimaru Kyoto store, linked underground to Karasuma and Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_la_risotteria_daimaru.notes: [Risotto · Daimaru Kyoto 8F] A department-store-top Italian specialising in Milanese risotto of aged Italian rice — the ossobuco on saffron risotto is the dish — with good-value lunch sets from ¥2,200 and a ¥500 happy hour. Part of the local Il Viale group. Open daily with Daimaru's hours.

roles: Run by the eldest son of a sister restaurant's owner, Milan-trained, per a July 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 October 2023 (Tabelog). One of the five shops of the Il Viale group named in our record kyoto_ca_del_viale ("Ca’ del Viale, TAVERNA il Viale, the gluten-free deli AL CAMINO, PANINOTECA and LA RISOTTERIA in the Daimaru Kyoto store"). A July 2026 reviewer writes it is run by the eldest son of a sister restaurant's owner, who trained in Milan.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 lunch guest found the porcini risotto (+¥1,100) short on porcini aroma and "just average" for ¥3,300.

kyoto_kissa_soiree.gf_detail: Ask. The menu is mostly drinks, jelly drinks, ice cream and floats, with cakes and thick toast; no gluten information is published (official menu).

kyoto_kissa_soiree.notes: [Kissaten · Kawaramachi, jelly punch under blue light since 1948] A two-floor coffee house by the Takase River, opened in 1948 and designed with artist friends of the founder: carved wood by the sculptor 池野禎春, blue lights chosen by a dye scholar, paintings by 東郷青児 and other Nika-kai artists, and no background music. Order the jelly punch (¥850) — five colours of jelly sparkling in soda, created by the second owner's wife in the 1970s — or a cream soda, with thick toast to share. roles: Family-run since 1948 (founder 元木和夫; jelly menu by 元木成子, wife of the second owner); current owner not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened on 11 April 1948, just after the war; the building and furnishings were created by the founder 元木和夫’s cultural friends — painter 佐々木良三, sculptor 池野禎春 (whose French training shaped the carved interior), dye scholar 上村六郎 (who suggested the blue light that makes women look beautiful and men young) and count-poet 𠮷井勇 (whose poem stands by the door); the line drawings on the cups were drawn for the shop by 東郷青児; 元木成子 (1937–1991), wife of the second owner, created the jelly drinks — first jelly milk for a daughter who disliked milk, then jelly punch from 1975 to bring in young women. The shop sells original Koransha cups and holds the jelly punch trademark (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "Soirée" means an evening party — a dreamlike room that feels like night even by day.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found the jelly almost tasteless and the soda faint, but loved how it looked.

kyoto_bakery_uki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of croissants, loaves, doughnuts and filled breads (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bakery_uki.vegan_detail: Ask. Hard breads and loaves may be plant-based, but croissants, cream bread, anpan and doughnuts use butter, dairy or egg; no ingredient information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bakery_uki.hours_raw: Tuesday to Saturday 10:00–17:00; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway only; the shop fits one group at a time, so a queue can form, especially at weekends — easiest just after opening on weekdays (May–July 2026). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). On Marutamachi-dori a short walk east of the Kawaramachi Marutamachi crossing; 3 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 29 January 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bakery_uki.notes: [Bakery · Marutamachi near Kawaramachi, one customer at a time] A shop so narrow it takes one group at a time, lined with breads from croissants and walnut loaves to cream bread and a light, barely greasy cinnamon doughnut (¥240); the loaf is the best seller. Prices are fair — croissants ¥360. Takeaway only; queues at weekends, quieter just after opening on weekdays. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 29 January 2020. Reviewers in 2026 describe a takeaway-only shop barely wide enough for one person, shelves of hard breads, croissants and savoury breads, and weekend queues.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor found the cinnamon doughnut far less oily than most — "almost non-greasy to the touch" — with a dense, chewy crumb.
"Although it's a popular spot that draws a line on weekends, it's relatively easy to get in right after opening on weekdays or in the early afternoon." — July 2026.
"The most shocking item was definitely the 'Cream Bread.'" — August 2026.

kyoto_komaitei_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Kansai-style sukiyaki cooked in soy sauce and sugar, with yuba and grilled tofu (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_komaitei_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Omi-beef sukiyaki cooked in beef fat and eaten with raw egg (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_komaitei_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:00, irregular closures; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); a reviewer found the phone manner curt and heard it followed a past no-show (December 2025). 60 seats in tatami rooms with sunken seating; private rooms; terrace dining in summer; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2025). Cards (Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). A machiya down a narrow lane off Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, by the Kamo river; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn exit 7 (Keihan) (Tabelog; October 2025).
kyoto_komaitei_kiyamachi.notes: [Sukiyaki · Kiyamachi by the Kamo, Omi beef the Kansai way] An old townhouse down a narrow lane off Kiyamachi, with tatami rooms and terrace seats in summer, where staff — sometimes the owner — cook Omi-beef sukiyaki at your table the Kansai way, searing the beef in its fat with sugar and soy, then serving it with egg, Kujo negi and yuba. About ¥10,000–15,000; some find it a little dear for the amount of meat. Popular with visitors. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a long-established sukiyaki house in a traditional machiya by the Kamo river, where staff cook the first slices for you; an August 2025 regular on a fifth visit saw the owner come out to cook too, and a December 2025 diner heard the curt phone manner dates from a past no-show.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 regular, visiting during the Gozan Okuribi, had the Omi-beef sukiyaki prepared by the staff — and by the owner, who came out to cook it in person.

"The phone service felt a bit curt, but I heard it's because of a past incident with a no-show cancellation." — December 2025, adding that there seemed to be fewer Chinese customers and more Japanese diners lately.
"Considering the quantity and quality of the meat, the price felt a bit on the higher side." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区木屋町三条上ル大阪町532、京阪三条駅7番出口から徒歩約3分、毎日 17:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、60席、座敷・掘りごたつ、個室、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年6月、英語): Omi beef のすき焼き、関西風でざらめと醤油、スタッフ (時に店主) が焼いてくれる、卵、九条ねぎ、湯葉、焼き豆腐、大きな椎茸、ご飯付き、柚子のシャーベット、木屋町の細い路地の町家、鴨川沿い、夏はテラス席、電話の対応がそっけないとの声 (無断キャンセルがあったため、2025年12月)、肉の量の割にやや高いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff cook the sukiyaki for you; book ahead (phone can be brisk); cards, e-money and QR.

kyoto_sumi_ryori_hiyori.gf_detail: Ask. A course of charcoal-cooked fish, meat and vegetables with soy, dashi and a fried dish with tartar sauce (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_sumi_ryori_hiyori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-meat course with dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumi_ryori_hiyori.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 daily (Tabelog); hours may change. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A seat fee is charged (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「心地よい空間とサービス維持のため、お席料を頂戴しております。」; the amount is not given). One omakase course, about ¥15,000–16,000 (February–March 2026); since September 2026 all guests start together for a while (September 2026, Japanese review). 11 counter seats facing an open kitchen, with a small garden; private hire (Tabelog; March 2026). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse on a quiet street south of the Imperial Palace; 9 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; August–September 2026). Opened 24 November 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumi_ryori_hiyori.notes: [Charcoal kaiseki · south of the Imperial Palace, a new eleven-seat counter] Opened in November 2025 in a renovated townhouse, this counter's young chef — trained at Sumibi Kappo Ifuki — builds an omakase around the charcoal: salt-aged Asahi shrimp, tuna head simmered for three days, sawara and sirloin cap seared over binchotan, then clay-pot rice crowned with firefly squid and uni. About ¥15,000–16,000 for the course, plus a seat fee. Open daily from 17:00.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed); young and newly independent (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the chef trained at a renowned charcoal-grill restaurant in Gion (March 2026), named as Sumibi Kappo Ifuki (August 2026), before opening independently in November 2025; both the restaurant and the owner are young (May and August 2026). The chef told a March 2026 diner the restaurant is still evolving.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-cooked fish and meat; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner thought the ¥15,000 course well worth it but found the meat’s presentation, including the drippings, a little lacking.
A June 2026 diner found the charcoal aroma subtle — a gentle spice rather than smoke — and noted some may find it too faint.
An April 2026 diner preferred the house tartar made with wasabi instead of pickles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂・海鮮、中京区毘沙門町542-2、丸太町駅から徒歩9分、神宮丸太町駅から10分、毎日17:00〜22:00、予約可、お席料あり (金額の記載なし)、カウンター11席、貸切可、禁煙、カード可、2025年11月24日オープン。口コミ (2026年2〜9月、英語と日本語): 御所南の改装した町家、炭火割烹の名店で修業した若い店主、炭を軸にした約11品のおまかせ、コース約15,000〜16,000円、塩で熟成した海老、三日炊いたまぐろの頭、土鍋の締め (ホタルイカと雲丹のせりご飯)、肉の盛り付けが物足りないという声、炭の香りが控えめという声、当面は一斉スタート (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; one omakase course; seat fee; cards accepted.

kyoto_pingping_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Taiwanese dishes with wheat dumpling wrappers, noodles, spring rolls and soy-based sauces (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pingping_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dumplings of pork and chives, squid balls, clams, oysters and pork-filled zongzi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pingping_gion.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and public holidays, following the restaurant’s calendar (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; walk-ins are often seated on weekdays, but it can be full at year-end (Tabelog; October 2025, January 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). A retro shop in a back lane of Gion, 1 min from the Gion bus stop (Tabelog; February 2026).
kyoto_pingping_gion.notes: [Taiwanese · Gion, dumplings in a back lane] A tiny, retro Taiwanese kitchen in a Gion back lane, a favourite second stop. Order the homemade boiled dumplings — twelve to a plate, heavy on chives — then squid balls, garlic-soy clams or danzai noodles, with warm Shaoxing wine. Some dishes are very spicy and salty. About ¥2,000–5,000. Cash only. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe an energetic owner, called "Mama", who jokes with guests and whose regulars come back for the same dishes year after year (2025–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found the dried-radish omelette and the rice vermicelli extremely spicy and salty — not for those who like mild food — but the dumplings good and the prices fair.
The owner told a November 2025 first-timer, half joking: "If you didn’t like it, please come again anyway!"
A January 2026 regular, turned away at year-end when it was full, came back for the clams and dumplings.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 台湾料理、東山区祇園富永町北側397 ピッケルビル1F、祇園バス停から徒歩1分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日曜・祝日休み (カレンダーに準じる)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、11席、禁煙。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 祇園の路地の台湾の家庭料理、自家製の水餃子 (12個)、イカ団子、台湾ソーセージ、しじみのにんにく醤油、牡蠣、牛タンの醤油煮、春巻き、ちまき、担仔麺、紹興酒、ママと呼ばれる明るい店主、辛くて塩辛い料理もあるという声、1人約2,000〜5,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from a short fixed menu; bring cash; walk-ins often fine on weekdays.

kyoto_okashi_kobo_favorite.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pies and tarts on wheat pastry (2026 reviews).
kyoto_okashi_kobo_favorite.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the pie crust is made with fermented butter, and there are cheese tarts and puddings (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_okashi_kobo_favorite.hours_raw: 11:00–20:00; closed Wednesday (open on public holidays) (Tabelog). Take-away only (Tabelog). Whole pies can be ordered ahead; pre-ordered pies may leave few slices by opening or mid-afternoon (Tabelog; June and August 2026). Tabelog lists PayPay, but a reviewer could not find the code and another says cash only — bring cash (Tabelog; August–September 2026). 2 min from the Shijo Nishinotoin bus stop, 6 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_okashi_kobo_favorite.notes: [Pastry · Shijo Nishinotoin, Kyoto's chunky apple pie] A small take-away pâtisserie west of Karasuma whose apple pie is more apple than pastry — thick, cinnamon-scented slices under a crisp fermented-butter crust, about ¥650 a slice — with seasonal fruit tarts and a baked cheese tart alongside. Slices go by mid-afternoon on busy days; order a whole pie ahead. Bring cash. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A long-standing neighbourhood pastry shop: reviewers have bought its apple pie for years (December 2020 to August 2026) and describe a master who runs it (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular arrived at the 11:00 opening to find the pre-ordered pies taken, but managed one still warm from the oven.
A June 2026 diner with a sweet tooth found the pie slightly lacking in sweetness and the crust firm.
An August 2026 diner noted prices have risen a few times in recent years but still found them reasonable.

cultural_comfort.note: Take-away counter; point and pay; bring cash.

kyoto_harise.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant discusses allergies and preferences in detail (Tabelog). Kaiseki with dashi and soy, tempura in an almond batter and a beef cutlet (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_harise.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: a kaiseki of fish, beef and dashi (2025–26 reviews). Ask when booking (Tabelog).
kyoto_harise.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 and dinner 17:00–21:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; menus, allergies, preferences and the purpose of the meal can be discussed in detail when booking (Tabelog). Full kaiseki in private rooms for 2 to 30; the mini kaiseki is served in the large upstairs hall, with tatami rooms with chairs (Tabelog; July 2026). 100 seats; non-smoking; cards and QR (Tabelog). Parking across the street (November 2025). South of Gojo; 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_harise.notes: [Kaiseki · Gojo, a ryotei of 350 years] A long-established Kyoto ryotei south of Gojo, more than 350 years old, with a courtyard and rooms for two to thirty — a favourite for family celebrations and memorial meals. Full kaiseki runs about ¥8,000–30,000; the mini kaiseki lunch (about ¥4,000–5,000) is served in the big upstairs hall. Seasonal, gently seasoned cooking with a few modern touches like an almond-batter tempura. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Kyoto-cuisine ryotei founded more than 350 years ago in Higashiyama Gojo. Reviewers speak of a history of about 360 years and a well-kept building (November–December 2025), and of a sister patisserie, Famille de Chie Hari Se, whose roll cakes appear at dessert (November 2025).

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 solo diner, booking the day before during Obon, was given a private room.
An October 2026 memorial lunch saw guests aged 91, 91 and 85 finish all ten dishes.
A November 2025 diner warned that the road in front and the parking are narrow.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (harise.com): 京都 東山 五条、創業三百五十余年の京料理 はり清。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区大黒町通五条下ル袋町、清水五条駅から徒歩5分、昼 11:30〜14:30・夜 17:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約可 (料理、アレルギー、好み、会の目的まで相談できる)、100席、個室 2〜30名 (ミニ懐石は2階の大広間)、禁煙、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 創業約360年、中庭、懐石1人約8,000〜30,000円、ミニ懐石約4,000〜5,000円、アーモンド衣の天ぷら、Miyazaki の牛カツ、自家製のあんこ、姉妹店 Famille de Chie Hari Se のロールケーキ、法事や祝いの席に。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and discuss allergies and the occasion; private rooms; cards and QR.

staff_allergy_handling.text: At booking the restaurant discusses the meal, individual allergies and preferences, and the purpose of the gathering in detail.

kyoto_takoyakushi_furukawa.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a set Japanese course on bonito or tuna dashi with soy-seasoned dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_takoyakushi_furukawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish course opening with a bonito or tuna broth, with crab, sea urchin, octopus and sea bream (2026 reviews).
kyoto_takoyakushi_furukawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:00, all guests starting together at 12:00 and 18:00; irregular closures; reservation only; arrive at least 5 minutes early; cancellation 100% from two days before. Lunch began in earnest in November 2025 (press release). No service charge: Tabelog’s English page says a service charge is added, but the Japanese original says 「なし」. BYO ¥5,000 a bottle (Tabelog). 8 counter seats (7 per the press release); no shorts or revealing clothes; no strong perfume; English menu; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Entered through the back of the izakaya 鯛之鯛 烏丸店 (press release; 2026 reviews). Opened 11 June 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_takoyakushi_furukawa.notes: [Japanese omakase · Shijo-Karasuma, behind an izakaya] Walk through the busy fish izakaya 鯛之鯛 and open the door at the back: an eight-seat hinoki counter where the owner, twelve years at 山玄茶, starts every course with a broth made in front of you from deep well water and bonito. Seasonal, beautifully plated dishes; lunch ¥11,000, dinner about ¥20,000. A Michelin Guide Selected restaurant. Reservation only; no strong perfume.

chef_bio.chef_name: 古川 毅 (owner, per a press release; no reading in a source)
roles: Owner-chef (press release: 店主 古川毅)
chef_bio.background: Per a press release on san-tatsu.jp: owner 古川毅 trained for twelve years at the Kyoto restaurant 山玄茶 before opening 蛸薬師ふるかわ; the restaurant was listed as a Michelin Guide Selected Restaurant and began full lunch service in November 2025; it sits behind the lively izakaya 鯛之鯛 near Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo stations, with a single-plank hinoki counter. Opened 11 June 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 praise the owner’s warmth and the sake recommendations.
chef_bio.specialty: Broth made to order from well water and bonito; seasonal omakase.

anecdotes.text: The course opens with a broth made from soft water drawn from 52 metres underground and bonito flakes, skimmed in front of the guest (August 2026).
A birthday guest in August 2026 was served a salt-baked sea bream.
"I think it would be hard to find the entrance if it’s your first time." — July 2026; the guest took home the house furikake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: プレスリリース (san-tatsu.jp、株式会社リバリュース): 蛸薬師ふるかわがミシュランガイドのセレクテッドレストランに掲載、2025年11月からランチ営業を本格的に開始、店主 古川毅は京都の名店「山玄茶」で12年間修行して開業、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅近くの居酒屋「鯛之鯛」の店内を抜けた奥の扉の先、檜の一枚板のカウンター7席。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区一蓮社町蛸薬師通烏丸東入ル300 パームビル1F、毎日 12:00〜14:00・18:00〜21:00 (12時・18時一斉スタート)、不定休、完全予約制、5分前までに来店、2日前から100%のキャンセル料、サービス料は日本語原文で「なし」(英語版の記載は誤訳)、持ち込み1本5,000円、カウンター8席、短パンや露出の多い服は不可、強い香水不可、英語メニュー、カード可、2024年6月11日オープン。口コミ (2026年5月〜9月、英語): 昼11,000円、夜20,000〜22,000円のおまかせ、深さ52mの井戸水と鰹節の一番だし、白神山地の軟水の鮪だし、蓮の葉の蓮根餅と紫雲丹と甘海老、毛蟹の蟹味噌、焼き茄子とすだちジュレ、蛸と蕎麦の実、鯛の塩釜焼き、黒蜜と生姜のデザート、自家製ふりかけ、店主の人柄、日本酒のすすめ。

kyoto_comme_chez_michel.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; bistro courses with terrines, rillettes and baguette, pastry desserts (Paris-Brest, Mont Blanc, tarte Tatin) (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_comme_chez_michel.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork rillettes, terrines, meat and fish mains finished with bouillon (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_comme_chez_michel.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–14:00 (L.O.), dinner 18:00–21:00 (L.O.); closed Wednesday (Thursday if Wednesday is a holiday) and one irregular day a month. Bookings by phone (official site); birthday messages on dessert with notice (April 2026). 18 seats: 10 at tables downstairs, 8 upstairs; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 29 April 2009 in the former obanzai restaurant 三月 (Tabelog).
kyoto_comme_chez_michel.notes: [French bistro · Oike, a Paris bistro’s Kyoto namesake] A small two-floor bistro in a former obanzai house, named after Chez Michel in Paris, where the chef trained three years under Thierry Breton. Everyday Parisian cooking with little butter or cream — rillettes, terrines, mushroom potage, roast Kyoto pork — and desserts from Blé Sucré training, by A/B/C course or à la carte. Lunch from about ¥3,000. One diner found the small rooms full of cooking smells by dessert (December 2024). Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 大川 (surname only, from the official site: シェフ大川; no given name or reading)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef trained at hotels in Japan, then spent five years in Paris, three of them under chef Thierry Breton at the bistro Chez Michel, and learned desserts at the pâtisserie Blé Sucré in the 12th arrondissement; on opening in Kyoto, the mentor urged the chef to become "the Chez Michel of Japan". Michelin Guide Kansai 2014 Bib Gourmand. Opened 29 April 2009 in the building that was the obanzai restaurant 三月 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: bistro cooking that knows its ingredients — meat on the bone, butter and cream kept down, finished with good bouillon — eaten happily, even with the fingers.
chef_bio.specialty: Bistro courses; Paris-Brest; rillettes and terrines.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 family enjoyed the Christmas course, though the smell of other tables’ mains lingered through dessert in the small room; the chef saw them off at the door.
An April 2026 birthday group chose from about five starters, mains and desserts on the day instead of fixing the menu when booking.
An October 2026 regular added a steak and was surprised by lentils and mash instead of fries.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (commechezmichel.com): コム シェ ミッシェル、フランス人が食べる本場のビストロフレンチを気軽に、ミシュランガイド関西2014 ビブグルマン、パリで日常的に食べられているビストロ料理、ランチとディナーにA・B・Cのコース、アラカルトも一人から、パリ12区 Blé Sucré でシェフが学んだデセール、店名はパリの名店 Chez Michel に近づきたいという思い、シェフ大川は国内のホテルで修行の後に渡仏、パリで5年、うち3年はシェフ ティエリー・ブルトンのもとで修行、師匠から「日本のシェミッシェルとなれ」、バターと生クリームを控えブイヨンで仕上げる、骨付き肉、パリ・ブレスト、中京区柳馬場通御池下る柳八幡町80番1、ランチ12:00〜14:00 (L.O.)、ディナー18:00〜21:00 (L.O.)、水曜休み (祝日の場合木曜)、月1回不定休、予約は電話。食べログ: フレンチ、18席 (1階テーブル10、2階テーブル8)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、2009年4月29日オープン (おばんざいの店「三月」だった建物)。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 豚のリエット、魚介のテリーヌ、猪のテリーヌ、きのこのポタージュ900円、グリーンピースのスープ、聖護院かぶらのピュレ、京丹後の鶏のバロティーヌ、京都ポークのロースト、牛頬肉のエストラゴン風、ステーキとレンズ豆とマッシュポテト、鯛のポワレ、モンブラン、タルト・タタン、ランチ3,000円台、誕生日のメッセージ、店が狭く料理の匂いがこもるという声。

kyoto_oshikoji_okada.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a dashi-based Kyoto kaiseki with soy-seasoned dishes and pressed sushi (official site; 2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_oshikoji_okada.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish kaiseki on bonito dashi — sweetfish, sea bream, hamo, crab, tuna — though reviewers note little or no meat (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_oshikoji_okada.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:00); dinner 17:30–20:30 (last entry); closed Sunday and Monday holidays (open on ordinary Mondays and other holidays). Reservation only; hard to book (2023 and 2025 reviews). Courses tax and service included: lunch ¥8,500; dinner ¥13,500, ¥16,500, ¥19,800 (official site). 13 seats: a counter of 7 (6 per a 2023 review) and a private room for 6; non-smoking; children by arrangement; AMEX only (official site; Tabelog). No service charge listed separately on Tabelog. Take-away boxes and mackerel sushi by order (official site). Opened June 2018; moved to this machiya in 2021 (official site; Tabelog gives 16 September 2021).
kyoto_oshikoji_okada.notes: [Kaiseki · Oshikoji-Takakura, a quiet chef and well water] A machiya south of the Imperial Palace where a quiet chef, once an opening cook at 祇園 なん波, serves textbook Kyoto kaiseki with little meat, its dashi made from well water fetched each morning. Seven counter seats and one private room; lunch ¥8,500, dinner from ¥13,500 all-in. Regulars return every season; reservations are hard to get. A 2022 diner found some seasoning salty. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 岡田 晃 (Okada Akira, per the official site)
chef_bio.origin: Born 13 September 1979 in 長野県千曲市 (official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: began in 1999 at the local kaiseki restaurant 竹葉亭, trained at 祇園はやかわ from 2002, joined 祇園 なん波 as opening staff in 2006 and served as its simmering cook, and opened 押小路岡田 with about six counter seats in June 2018; in 2021 moved across Oshikoji to a larger machiya with a gallery upstairs; draws dashi water from springs around the shop every morning; also caters boxed meals for guests of the hotel 東山 四季花木. A January 2022 reviewer saw the owner working almost alone at the old shop, with more help after the move.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「ただ直向きに 丹念に、京都の 想い出の料理 こしらえます」 — true flavour lies in well water, ingredients that meet in season and a faint scent of dashi, not costly ingredients or showmanship.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki; pressed sushi; dashi.

anecdotes.text: A guest who once gave a business card at the old shop received New Year cards every year after (January 2022).
"It felt like being in a textbook on Japanese cooking." — December 2023; the party of six brought a magnum of brut and was welcomed.
"I did find the seasoning a bit on the salty side." — May 2022.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (oshikoji-okada.com): 押小路 岡田、京料理、「ただ直向きに 丹念に、京都の 想い出の料理 こしらえます」、走り・旬・名残、高価な食材や華やかな演出より毎朝近所に汲みに行く地下水と出会い物とほのかなだし、押小路通高倉西北角の京町家、寡黙な店主、カウンター7席と6人掛けの個室、昼7,700円・夜12,100円と16,500円 (旧表記)、お品書きは昼8,500円、夜13,500円・16,500円・19,800円 (税サ込)、岡田 晃 (Okada Akira) は1979年9月13日長野県千曲市生まれ、1999年地元の竹葉亭、2002年祇園はやかわ、2006年祇園なん波のオープンスタッフで煮方、2018年6月にカウンター6席ほどで独立、2021年に北西向かいの一回り大きな店へ移転し2階にギャラリー、東山 四季花木のお重のケータリング、持ち帰りの折詰4,320円・6,480円、ちりめん山椒・塩昆布1,620円、鯖寿司1本4,860円、昼12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 13:00)、夜17:30〜20:30 (最終入店)、日曜と祝日の月曜休み、全面禁煙。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区押小路高倉東入瓦町565-2、完全予約制、13席、カードは AMEX、2021年9月16日オープン。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 移転で内装と料理がさらによくなった、肉をほとんど使わない伝統的な京料理、教科書のような和食、長芋豆腐と渡り蟹といくら、松葉蟹と湯葉、鮎と大根のお椀、瀬戸内の鯛、鮪、鰹、かますの焼き霜の棒寿司、鱧の子、新生姜の炊き込みご飯、デザート2品、予約が取りにくい、やや塩辛いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only through the official booking link; set courses; a quiet counter.

kyoto_goken_uiro_honten.gf_detail: Ask. No ingredient information; uiro, mitarashi dango in soy glaze, kuzumochi and fu-manju downstairs, and katsu curry and omurice in the upstairs café (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goken_uiro_honten.vegan_detail: Ask. Uiro, minazuki and bean-paste sweets may suit, but no ingredient information is given; the café serves katsu curry and omurice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goken_uiro_honten.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours and the official site was under maintenance on 5 November 2026; reviewers came at lunchtime on weekdays and weekends (2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Wagashi shop downstairs; a Showa-retro café upstairs serving lunch (katsu curry ¥1,000, omurice, set meals) and an uiro parfait (2026 reviews). Smoking allowed; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. A second shop sells at JR 京都伊勢丹 B1F (Tabelog), with pop-ups at department stores (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goken_uiro_honten.notes: [Uiro & wagashi · Gojozaka, with a retro café upstairs] The main shop of a long-established uiro maker near Kiyomizu-Gojo: fresh uiro that keeps only two days, giant mitarashi dango and seasonal minazuki downstairs, and upstairs a bright Showa-era café where locals eat katsu curry and omurice at lunch. Staff are kind and explain what keeps. Hours not published — check before going. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established uiro shop at Gojozaka, with wagashi sold downstairs and a café on the second floor that feels like a Showa-era local lunch spot. A second shop is in the basement of JR 京都伊勢丹 (Tabelog), and the shop has run pop-ups at department stores in Kyoto and at Daimaru Tokyo (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 café guest found no uiro or dango on the upstairs menu; the staff offered to bring dango up from downstairs.
The staff explained that fresh uiro is better but keeps only two days, so an August 2026 visitor took a vacuum pack instead.
"Personally, it was the best uiro I've ever tasted." — August 2026, on the brown-sugar uiro.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 五建 ういろ 本店 (五建外良屋)、和菓子・喫茶店、東山区五条橋東2丁目18番地1、清水五条駅から徒歩約2分、予約不可、営業時間の記載なし、喫煙可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、ほかにジェイアール京都伊勢丹B1Fの店。公式サイト (gokenuiro.jp) は2026年11月5日時点でメンテナンス中。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 生ういろ (黒糖、栗、よもぎ)、生は日持ち2日で真空パックもある、水無月、葛餅、わらび餅、大玉みたらし、麩まんじゅう、赤飯まんじゅう、2階は昭和レトロのカフェで地元の人の昼ごはん、カツカレー1,000円、オムライス、定食、ういろパフェ、親切なスタッフ、高島屋や大丸東京店の催事。

kyoto_nikumabushi_mare.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu over rice with a "secret sauce" and dashi to pour over; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nikumabushi_mare.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu restaurant; the broth and egg-yolk sauce come with every bowl (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nikumabushi_mare.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–21:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken; one order per person except small children, no sharing; Tabelog says both that a seat cannot be held past 10 minutes late and that tables are held for one hour from the booked time (Tabelog). 13 counter seats; children welcome, strollers allowed; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). On the south side of a lane 70 m east of Hanamikoji, north of Shijo; 1 min from the Gion bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_nikumabushi_mare.notes: [Wagyu hitsumabushi · Gion north of Shijo] A 13-seat counter serving black wagyu, grilled rare, over rice to eat in three stages like eel hitsumabushi — finishing with broth. Bowls about ¥2,800–3,800; sets add shabu-shabu and matcha ice cream. Popular with overseas visitors; book. Open daily, lunch and dinner.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 November 2018 (Tabelog). Per the operator: a specialist in wagyu hitsumabushi with a secret sauce; a black wagyu ichibo steak box added as a new menu.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 returnee found part-time staff arguing over the seating, and the meat looking different from before.
In October 2026 one diner noticed being the only Japanese customer — everyone else was from overseas.
A February 2026 solo traveller added Kyoto black shichimi to change the flavour and finished every grain.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 肉まぶし専門店 稀、丼・牛肉料理、東山区祇園町北側338-1 祇園川長ビル 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、四条花見小路を北へ、東へ70mの南側、月〜金 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、土日祝 11:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:00)・17:00〜21:00、1人1オーダー制、10分以上の遅刻は席の用意ができない、予約時刻から1時間で席を解除、13席、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2018年11月15日オープン、秘伝のたれの和牛ひつまぶし、黒毛和牛のイチボのステーキ重。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 黒毛和牛のうちひらの肉まぶし2,800円、希少部位3,800円、薬味と出汁、卵黄のソース、MARE セット (しゃぶしゃぶ、抹茶アイス)、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (October 2026); one order per person; book ahead.

kyoto_kappou_iimori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of Toyama seafood and dashi (Tabelog; 2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_kappou_iimori.hours_raw: Mon–Sat lunch 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last entry 19:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Courses by reservation; lunch only when booked — a ¥4,500 lunch course (Tabelog). Service charge: none noted — Tabelog's Japanese original: "特にございません". 10 seats: a 5-seat counter and a tatami room upstairs for up to 6; smoking only on the 2nd floor; children welcome; cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley in Gion north of Shijo — reviewers warn it is hard to find (2024–26 reviews); 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kappou_iimori.notes: [Kappo · Gion, Toyama seafood] A hidden Gion kappo down a narrow alley, where a couple from Toyama serve fish sent daily from home — kombu-cured amadai, white shrimp, seko crab — with Kyoto vegetables and claypot rice. Five counter seats and a tatami room. Lunch from ¥4,500 by booking; dinner about ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef from Toyama (unnamed), with a spouse — per 2024–26 reviews
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2002 (Tabelog). Per the operator: fresh seasonal seafood sent daily from Toyama. Per 2024–26 reviews: the owner couple are from Toyama and welcome first-timers warmly; a July 2024 reviewer says the Toyama tuna has come in for about seven years.

anecdotes.text: Unlike many traditional ryotei, the chef couple made first-time visitors very welcome — July 2026.
On a hot July 2024 day, water had been sprinkled outside the alley entrance, and the guest was shown to an elegant room upstairs.
An August 2026 business traveller ended with claypot rice and wondered whether crab comes in winter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 割烹 いいもり、日本料理・海鮮、東山区祇園町北側347-100、祇園四条から徒歩10分、月〜土 12:00〜14:00 (最終入店12:30)・17:00〜21:00 (最終入店19:00)、日曜休み、サービス料: 特にございません、10席 (カウンター5、2階の座敷6)、2階のみ喫煙可、子供可、2002年4月1日オープン、富山から毎日届く旬の魚介と京野菜、昼の4,500円のコース (要予約)。口コミ (2023年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 富山出身の店主夫婦、蟹といくらの茶碗蒸し、せこ蟹、鯖、富山の鮪、甘鯛の昆布締め、水蛸、鱧の椀、白海老、ホタルイカ、土鍋ご飯、7,000円の昼、9,000円のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; lunch only by reservation; the alley entrance is hard to find.

kyoto_neuf_creperie.gf_detail: Ask. Galettes are buckwheat-based but the sweet crêpes are wheat (September 2026 review); the buckwheat share and kitchen practice are not stated; no gluten information.
kyoto_neuf_creperie.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: galettes of ham, egg and cheese, and crêpes with butter, custard and cream (2026 reviews).
kyoto_neuf_creperie.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–16:30 (last order 16:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog); a set of galette, crêpe and drink at lunch, 11:00–15:00 (August 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats (4 at the counter); takeaway; children welcome, strollers allowed; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Ebisugawa-dori west of Takakura; 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_neuf_creperie.notes: [Galettes & crêpes · south of the Imperial Palace] A bright, relaxed Breton crêperie on Ebisugawa-dori: crisp buckwheat galettes (ham, cheese, egg; peach and prosciutto in summer) and chewy sweet crêpes like Échiré butter and sugar. Lunch sets about ¥2,000. Cash only; book at weekends. Open daily from 10:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 September 2015 (Tabelog). A five-time regular orders the galette, crêpe and drink set at lunch (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A first-time visitor in September 2026 learned that galettes are buckwheat and crêpes wheat — and that galettes are not always savoury.
A galette lover who dislikes avocado swapped the classic complète for the mozzarella, tomato and meat-sauce galette — October 2026.
Walking in without a booking on a weekday afternoon, an October 2026 diner was told to sit anywhere; three more groups followed.

kyoto_tachinomi_torizuki.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with tare or salt, steamed tsukune, spaghetti salad, grilled rice balls and ramen; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_torizuki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori bar (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_torizuki.hours_raw: 15:00–22:30 daily (food last order 21:30); closed over New Year (Tabelog). The ground floor is standing only and takes no bookings; the 2nd floor has tables by reservation only, for 3 or more on a party course or with a ¥1,500 food order (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; September 2026). 26 standing places downstairs, 18 seats upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). In a maze-like alley near Bukkoji and Karasuma — directions on its Instagram (2026 reviews); 5 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tachinomi_torizuki.notes: [Yakitori standing bar · near Karasuma-Bukkoji] A clean, lively standing bar hidden in an alley near Shijo-Karasuma: small, well-grilled skewers, steamed tsukune that eats like shumai, and a ¥500 chicken ramen to finish. About ¥2,000–4,000. Walk in from 3 pm (no bookings downstairs); PayPay or cash. Open daily.

roles: Operator: 株式会社クラマ計画 (KURAMA PROJECT); no person named
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 March 2023 and, per the operator, reopened in November 2024 (Tabelog). It belongs to KURAMA PROJECT, an Osaka company that calls itself an "organised group of individual shops" and lists about sixteen differently named bars and restaurants (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: "組織的 個人店 集団" — an organised group of individual shops.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at 4 pm on an October 2026 weekday, a diner found about seven groups already there.
A September 2026 first-timer, invited by a friend, called the steamed tsukune a dish "you can't miss" — fluffy like shumai, yet crunchy like tsukune.
A September 2026 weekend crowd seemed mostly in its thirties; there were a few minor order mistakes in the bustle.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 立呑トリズキ、立ち飲み・焼き鳥、下京区上柳町315-15、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、15:00〜22:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30)、年末年始以外は無休、1階は立ち飲みで予約不可、2階はテーブル席で予約のみ (3名以上、宴会コースか1,500円の料理付き)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、2023年3月14日オープン、2024年11月リニューアル。公式サイト (kuramaproject.com): 株式会社クラマ計画、組織的 個人店 集団、TORIZUKI 鶏料理×路地裏 阪急烏丸駅徒歩3分ほか約16店。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 蒸しつくね、生つくねと卵黄、焦がし醤油、ハツのたれ、レバー、鴨ねぎ、ささみのわさび、おばんざい3種、わさびマヨのスパゲティサラダ、雲丹醤油の焼きおにぎり、鶏ガララーメン500円、焼酎。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-in standing bar; no cards (PayPay ok); many overseas visitors (October 2026).

kyoto_kawama_shokudo_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Rice burgers (rice buns with nori and dashi flavours) alongside bread sandwiches, hot dogs, muffins and cookies; sauces not described for gluten (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kawama_shokudo_gojo.vegan_detail: Ask. Fillings are mostly mackerel, egg and meat; chili con carne and taco rice plates; a fruit yogurt; no plant-only item named (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kawama_shokudo_gojo.hours_raw: 9:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30) daily, holidays included (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cashless only — no cash; cards, IC cards, other e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Pay first (June 2026). 18 seats with river-facing windows; Wi-Fi and power outlets; terrace where pets are allowed; smoking outside only (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Takeaway in burger bags (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). At the foot of Gojo Ohashi on the west bank, 3 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; October 2025). Opened 10 February 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kawama_shokudo_gojo.notes: [Café · Gojo Ohashi, rice burgers by the river] A small blue-and-grey café at the foot of Gojo Ohashi whose big windows look straight onto the Kamo River. Rice burgers with a nori-and-dashi aroma and bread sandwiches (the mackerel one is a regular favourite) are made to order and come in burger bags — eat in, or take the bag down to the riverbank. Art on the walls. Cashless only — no cash; open daily 9:00–17:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 10 February 2020.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 regular found the mackerel sandwich wetter with more pickles than before and preferred the old version, and wished for a soup set instead of bread-based desserts.
A June 2025 regular likes taking food out to eat on the Kamo riverbank.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 川間食堂 (kawama cafe)、カフェ・サンドイッチ・バル、下京区都市町141-2、清水五条駅から徒歩3分、毎日9:00〜17:00 (L.O.16:30)、予約不可、キャッシュレスのみ (現金不可)、18席、禁煙 (屋外で喫煙可)、Wi-Fi、電源、テラスはペット可、テイクアウト、子ども可、2020年2月10日オープン。店の紹介: 注文を受けてから作るサンドとライスバーガー、バーガー袋で提供、鴨川の眺め。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 鯖サンド、厚焼き玉子サンド、ホットドッグ、チリコンカンとタコライスのランチプレート、川間弁当1,000円、玉子焼きとねぎ味噌500円、セットは100円引き、エスプレッソ、マンゴーラッシー、店内にアート。

cultural_comfort.note: Cashless only (no cash); pay first; river views.

kyoto_roko_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki and lunches with dashi soups, white-miso hot pot, yuba and nama-fu gratin (nama-fu is wheat gluten), obanzai; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_roko_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based kaiseki with hamo, ayu and pork; cheese in the gratin and hot pot (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_roko_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:20, dinner 17:30–21:30, daily; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations online only — via Instagram, Google or TableCheck; phone only for 9 or more (Tabelog). Riverside yuka seating until 15 October, indoors when it rains (Tabelog); no yuka lunch in July because of the heat (July 2026). 10% service charge (Tabelog, original サービス料10%); one drink per person (September 2026). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB per Tabelog, but a September 2026 lunch party was told lunch is cash only. 20 seats plus private rooms for 2–20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi north of Oike, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 2 (Tabelog).
kyoto_roko_kiyamachi.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Kiyamachi, lunch on the Kamo River yuka] A riverside restaurant on Kiyamachi whose yuka over the Kamo River runs into mid-October. Lunch is the value (about ¥2,000–3,000): white-miso hot pot or a gratin of nama-fu and yuba with obanzai; dinner is seasonal mini-kaiseki with hamo and ayu in summer. Book online, well ahead. 10% service and a one-drink rule; one September 2026 group felt rushed and was surprised that lunch was cash only.

chef_bio.background: Not stated in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Riverside lunch; summer hamo and ayu.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner had a seat moved to the best riverside spot halfway through the course.
A September 2026 party of eight, told at lunch that payment was cash only despite cards being listed, felt hurried out for the next booking; the reviewer will not return.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 露瑚、日本料理・カフェ、中京区上樵木町491-6、市役所前駅2番出口から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜14:20、夜17:30〜21:30、不定休、予約はインスタグラム・Google・TableCheck から (9名以上は電話)、川床は10月15日まで (雨天は室内)、サービス料10%、カード (VISA、Master、JCB)、20席、個室、禁煙、英語メニュー。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昼は約1,890円〜2,900円とサービス料、白味噌の鍋とチーズ、生麩と湯葉のグラタンか豚の角煮、おばんざい、ちりめんじゃこのご飯、ほうじ茶プリン、夜は鱧や鮎のミニ会席、7月は暑さで昼の川床なし、1ドリンク制、2026年9月には昼は現金のみと言われ急かされたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; book online only; 10% service charge; bring cash for lunch to be safe.

kyoto_wine_bistro_plein_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Bistro plates, steaks, Rossini and pasta of the day; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wine_bistro_plein_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-and-fish bistro — wagyu, venison stew, foie-gras Rossini, mentaiko (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wine_bistro_plein_gion.hours_raw: 18:00–1:00 (last entry 24:30), Monday–Saturday and holidays; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; two-hour limit when busy; walk-ins after 21:00 possible (Tabelog; July 2026). Table charge ¥550, no service charge (Tabelog, original text). Private rooms: small (2–5) ¥4,400, larger (2–8) ¥10,000 (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 33 seats: 22 at the counter and two private rooms (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff; sommeliers (Tabelog; July 2026). Children only in private rooms (Tabelog). Ground floor of KYOTO GION HOTEL on Hanamikoji, next to Lawson, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 March 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_wine_bistro_plein_gion.notes: [Wine bistro · Gion Hanamikoji, open until 1 a.m.] The PLEIN group’s first venture outside Tokyo: a calm counter bistro on the ground floor of a Hanamikoji hotel, open until 1 a.m. Sommeliers pour by the glass from ¥900 or pair to taste, and the kitchen sends out the much-ordered truffle daikon, appetizer platters, Rossini, steaks and pasta of the day; courses run late too. ¥550 charge; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 14 March 2024. A May 2026 reviewer calls it the first shop of the Ginza PLEIN group outside Tokyo. A 17 March 2026 press release (zaikei) about the sister shop PLEIN BIS says the group runs mainly French and bistro shops in Tokyo and Kyoto, from PLEIN Ginza Honten, Toranomon Hills and Kyoto Gion.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner came after 9 p.m. without a booking and still had a full course.
An October 2026 pair booked for 22:30; the steak, ordered first, was so generous that there was no room left for fish.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and staff; ¥550 charge; open until 1 a.m.

kyoto_modern_terrace_okazaki.gf_detail: Ask. Western-Japanese lunch courses and plates — soufflé-omelette hayashi rice, pasta, shio-koji fried chicken, fried items with cheese — and cakes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_modern_terrace_okazaki.vegan_detail: Ask. A spaghetti with twelve vegetables is on the menu, but nothing is described as plant-only (October 2026).
kyoto_modern_terrace_okazaki.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 daily (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 21:00); lunch menu from 11:00, café from 15:00, dinner from 17:00; hours may change for private hire; irregular closures; shorter hours over New Year (Tabelog). Reservations for indoor seats only — lunch course only at lunch; the terrace only for the beer-terrace plan to the end of September (Tabelog). Queues at peak times: take a numbered ticket and get a phone call (September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 160 seats indoors and on the terrace; pets welcome (Tabelog). Non-smoking, including the terrace (Tabelog). Free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog). Second floor of the ROHM Theatre Kyoto Park Plaza in Okazaki, about 10 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 10 January 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_modern_terrace_okazaki.notes: [Café-restaurant · Okazaki, a grand room in ROHM Theatre] A big, high-ceilinged café-restaurant above the ROHM Theatre Kyoto plaza in Okazaki, with green walls and a terrace where dogs are welcome. Lunch is Western-Japanese — a puffed soufflé omelette over hayashi rice, vegetable spaghetti, shio-koji fried chicken — and you can finish with wagashi from 亀屋良長. Handy before a show at the theatre or after Heian Shrine; expect a numbered queue at peak times.

roles: Kitchen (unnamed); listed on the Kyoto Okazaki T-SITE floor guide
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 10 January 2016; the shop page sits on the T-SITE floor guide for the ROHM Theatre building.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor took a numbered ticket at 2 p.m., waited outside, and was called by phone when a table was ready.
An October 2026 diner watched the soufflé omelette arrive puffed up and fall flat almost at once.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都モダンテラス、カフェ・洋食・日本料理、左京区岡崎最勝寺町13 ロームシアター京都パークプラザ2F、東山駅1番出口から徒歩約10分、毎日11:00〜22:00 (フードL.O.20:00、ドリンクL.O.21:00)、ランチは11時、カフェは15時、ディナーは17時から、不定休、予約は店内席のみ (昼はランチコースのみ)、テラスは9月末までビアテラスのプランのみ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、160席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、車椅子可、子ども・ペット可、2016年1月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): スフレオムハヤシ、12種の野菜のスパゲッティ、塩麹の唐揚げとトマトソース、モダンテラスランチコース、亀屋良長の和菓子、整理券と電話の呼び出し。

cultural_comfort.note: Numbered-ticket queue with a phone call; wheelchair accessible; pets on the terrace.

kyoto_ushinohone_anaza.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, charcoal grills and kamameshi alongside a beef stew served with bread, spring rolls and fried dishes; Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but no gluten information is published (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_ushinohone_anaza.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and vegetables come direct from contract farmers, but most dishes use dashi, fish or meat; no ingredient list is published (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_ushinohone_anaza.hours_raw: 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); open daily (official site; Tabelog lists irregular closures). Bookings by phone or web; same-day cancellations may be charged 100% of the food (official site). 48 seats: a counter of 8 and tatami rooms of 40, all with sunken seating, shoes off; an attic-like 2nd-floor room for up to 20, private hire from 12 (official site; August 2026). Cards and PayPay (official site). On Sanjo-dori west of Tominokoji in a renovated townhouse; 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn, 7 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi or Karasuma Stn (official site).
kyoto_ushinohone_anaza.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo, obanzai and beef stew in a townhouse] A shoes-off townhouse izakaya on Sanjo-dori with sunken seating and an attic-like room upstairs, part of the local うしのほね group. Start with a plate of obanzai and seasonal sashimi, add charcoal grills, spring rolls or kamameshi, and do not miss the signature beef stew with unlimited bread. Courses run about ¥5,000–5,500. Friendly, quick staff; open every evening to 23:30.

roles: Head chef not named; operator 株式会社セカンダイズ (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Japanese-style izakaya on Sanjo-dori using produce sent direct from contract farmers, with seasonal kamameshi and charcoal grills; part of the うしのほね group, which also has うしのほね 本店 and 草風土 うしのほね (Tabelog crawl). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社セカンダイズ (NTA corporate-number site). An October 2026 regular praises the head chef’s training of the energetic staff.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 family of four found a handwritten note on the table saying "please relax and enjoy your time".
An October 2026 diner says a friend makes a point of coming back for the beef stew on every visit to Japan.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ushinohone-anaza.com): 烏丸御池の和食居酒屋 うしのほねあなざ、三条通に面した町屋居酒屋、契約農家さん直送の野菜、旬の釜飯、炭火焼、カウンターとテーブルはいずれも掘りごたつ、2F は屋根裏の隠れ家のようなお座敷 (最大20名、12名以上で貸切)、中京区三条富小路西入ル中之町15-1、阪急京都河原町駅・烏丸駅より徒歩7分、烏丸御池駅より徒歩5分、17:00〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、定休日無し、48席 (カウンター8、お座敷40)、カード・PayPay 可、当日キャンセルは料理代金の100%の場合あり、インボイス T8130001006678 (株式会社セカンダイズ)。食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理・魚介料理、不定休、ベジタリアンメニュー、子ども可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): ビーフシチューとおかわり自由のパン、おばんざい盛り合わせ、刺身、つくね、カレー春巻き、コース5,000〜5,500円。

cultural_comfort.note: English site; shoes off; sunken seating.

kyoto_plancha_ken.gf_detail: Ask when booking — Tabelog’s booking note asks guests with a gluten allergy to say so when reserving, and the restaurant will try to accommodate. Courses include sauces, baked cheese curry or curry as a finish, and dessert (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_plancha_ken.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, Matsusaka beef, lobster, abalone and foie gras teppanyaki courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_plancha_ken.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:00) Tuesday to Friday, holidays and the day before; also lunch 12:00–14:30 on Saturday and Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; gluten-allergic guests should say so when booking (Tabelog). No service charge; a seat charge of ¥600 per person, ¥1,100 from 31 December to 3 January (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料なし、チャージ料お一人600円（税込）12月31日から1月3日まではチャージ料1100円（税込）」). 22 seats with a counter and a semi-private room; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On the corner of the lane into Hanamikoji-Tominagacho, past a tobacco shop; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog). Opened 14 February 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_plancha_ken.notes: [Teppanyaki · Gion, wagyu and lobster on a back lane] A teppanyaki counter on a quiet lane off Hanamikoji, run by a chef from a hotel teppanyaki background, per reviewers. Courses (about ¥8,800–10,500) bring wagyu tataki, Matsusaka beef grilled shabu-shabu, a live Canadian lobster shown before cooking, and an A5 steak flambéed in front of you, finishing with cheese curry. Gluten-allergic guests can ask when booking. No service charge, but a ¥600 seat charge. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (the invoice holder); reviewers describe a master chef with hotel teppanyaki experience
chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 浅沼 健史, for the shop’s invoice number. October 2026 reviewers say the restaurant is run by a chef who was head chef at a prestigious hotel, with a gentle, playful manner. Opened 14 February 2014 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 birthday couple lifted the live lobster for a photo before it was cooked, and got a birthday plate for dessert.
An October 2026 diner was surprised by the beef-rich baked curry as the closing dish and was given a tenugui to take home.

kyoto_le_chene_chourakukan.vegan_detail: Ask in advance — the restaurant takes restrictions for the whole party ahead of time; courses centre on fish, duck, meat and butter sauces with Kyoto vegetables (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_le_chene_chourakukan.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:30 (last entry 14:00) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last entry 19:30); closed Tuesday and one irregular day a month (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (15% from 31 December to 5 January), per Tabelog. Allergies and restrictions (including pregnancy, caffeine and alcohol in cooking) must be told in advance for the whole party (Tabelog). About 10 parking spaces at the east front entrance; 7 min from the Gion bus stop, 11 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Inside 長楽館, a Meiji-era Western-style mansion in Maruyama Park that also houses a dessert café and a hotel; meals are served in the historic rooms or a newer annex (2025–26 reviews). Cards (Tabelog).
kyoto_le_chene_chourakukan.notes: [French · Maruyama Park, dining in a Meiji mansion] The main dining room of 長楽館, a Western-style mansion built in the Meiji era by a tobacco magnate as a guesthouse and now an Important Cultural Property, per reviewers. Chef Kazuki Hashimoto cooks French courses around Kyoto produce the chef sources in person — Wakasa mackerel with heshiko, rare omohata with beurre blanc, local Nanatani duck — served under high ceilings (dress warmly in winter) or in the annex. Lunch from ¥12,100; 10% service. The chef often greets diners after the meal. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Chef (January 2026 review); operator 株式会社長楽館 (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per 2025–26 reviewers: 長楽館 was built in the Meiji era as a guesthouse by a prominent businessman and was used to welcome foreign guests; it is an Important Cultural Property; the restaurant is named after the founder’s family crest of three oak leaves; chef Kazuki Hashimoto personally sources Kyoto vegetables and has long used local Nanatani duck (January 2026). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社長楽館 (NTA corporate-number site). The same building’s dessert café is a separate record. Chef’s name known only in Latin letters.
chef_bio.specialty: French courses with Kyoto vegetables; Nanatani duck.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner warns the high-ceilinged historic rooms feel chilly in winter.
A June 2026 hotel guest who stayed on points paid for dinner and called six glasses of pairing wine for ¥12,000, including Dom Pérignon, a good deal.
A February 2026 diner was greeted by the chef after the meal.

kyoto_kamogawa_takashi.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled Omi beef with sauces, grilled sukiyaki dipped in egg, beef bowls, croquettes and cutlets, and noodles to finish; no gluten information is published (official site; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kamogawa_takashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Omi beef restaurant — even the vegetables are grilled in Omi beef fat (official site; February 2026).
kyoto_kamogawa_takashi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:00) Monday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30) Monday and Wednesday to Sunday; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Phone bookings only at 10:00–11:00 and 17:00–18:00 (Tabelog). Private and semi-private rooms in an old house (June and August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR including UnionPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On Nakamachi-dori north of Takeyamachi; about 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kamogawa_takashi.notes: [Yakiniku · Marutamachi, Omi Hino beef from one farm] A beef restaurant in an old house near the Imperial Palace that serves only Omi Hino beef from the Okazaki farm, whose cows are raised long and unhurried. Lunch is a bargain — an Omi beef bowl with namul and soup for ¥500 — while dinner is a meat kaiseki (from about ¥7,800) of rare cuts grilled over charcoal on a shichirin, grilled sukiyaki in egg and noodles to finish. Private rooms; phone bookings at set hours only. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Chef not named; operator 株式会社Ｍｕｎｄｏ Ｒｉｃｏ (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: after tasting Omi Hino beef at the Okazaki farm in Shiga, the owners set out to serve only that farm’s beef — heifers fattened slowly to 36–40 months in a calm environment on the farm’s own feed — grilled simply over charcoal. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社Ｍｕｎｄｏ Ｒｉｃｏ (NTA corporate-number site). Reviewers describe a friendly chef and grill master (February 2026) and a young manager (August 2026); one guest from Tokyo has come back five or six times (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "ただ純粋に本物をお届けしたい" — simply to serve the real thing.
chef_bio.specialty: Okazaki-farm Omi Hino beef; grilled sukiyaki; ¥500 beef bowl lunch.

anecdotes.text: A regular of about 20 visits always looks forward to the charcoal-grilled sukiyaki, rolled and dipped in raw egg, and the creative dessert.

kyoto_fukuya_kyoto_yamagata.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick Yamagata soba and torichūka ramen in soy-based chicken-and-bonito broths, with saba sushi and dashi rice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_fukuya_kyoto_yamagata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat soba with chicken in chicken-and-bonito broth; other dishes include saba sushi and shirasu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_fukuya_kyoto_yamagata.hours_raw: Wednesday to Sunday 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); evenings can be fully booked (September 2026). Lunch queues of 2–5 groups are common, and the kitchen boils four servings at a time, so waits can run long (June–July 2026). 16 seats: 10 at the counter, 6 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR (Tabelog). A rebuilt old townhouse at the end of a narrow alley behind a coin parking lot, on Sanjo east of Higashinotoin — maps can lead to the car park instead (Tabelog; official site; 2026 reviews). First anniversary in July 2020 (official site).
kyoto_fukuya_kyoto_yamagata.notes: [Yamagata soba · Sanjo Higashinotoin, hidden behind a car park] A hand-built old townhouse at the end of an alley behind a coin car park, serving the food of the owner's home, Yamagata: thick, chewy "niku soba" with chicken, cold or hot (¥1,200), chilled torichūka, saba sushi, and Yamagata sake and snacks at night. Expect a queue at lunch — the kitchen cooks four bowls at a time, and one July 2026 visitor waited 90 minutes all told. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.origin: Yamagata (official site: "the culture of the owner's home, Yamagata").
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a hideaway at the back of an alley at Sanjo Higashinotoin, built around Yamagata meat soba, Yamagata sake and Yamagata dishes, in an old house rebuilt almost entirely by the owner and staff from old timber and tools; the owner's other shops are ふくや大町 (the main shop) and ふくや六地蔵 in Kamakura; the Kyoto shop marked its first anniversary in July 2020.
chef_bio.philosophy: A place where the cultures of Yamagata, Kamakura and Kyoto meet (official site).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner, once hooked on Yamagata meat soba while living in Tohoku, felt shy ordering "tsuttai niku soba" by its menu name — and found the noodles a little too hard.
A July 2026 guest queued 30 minutes while seats sat empty inside, waited over an hour and a half in all, and found a loud regular distracting: "It's a shame because the food was delicious."
An October 2026 visitor, sent to a parking lot by Google, found the shop at the end of the alley on a later try and paired Dewazakura and Toko with Yamagata nameko.

kyoto_curd_mitsui_garden.vegan_detail: Some vegan options per Tabelog, which lists vegan and vegetarian options and allergy information; the menu is built on house-made cheese, so ask (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

kyoto_curd_mitsui_garden.notes: [Italian · Sanjo, hotel courtyard, cheese made every morning] The Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Sanjo Premier's all-day restaurant, built around an in-house cheese workshop: ricotta, burrata and mozzarella made each morning from Tanba milk, on a ¥2,420 deli-plate lunch, on fresh pastas (about ¥2,000–3,100), or at a cheese-laden breakfast buffet (about ¥3,800). Bright room over a green courtyard, a dog-friendly terrace, mostly overseas hotel guests at breakfast. 10% service at dinner. Open 7:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Italian dining of Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Sanjo Premier, with fresh cheese made every morning from milk delivered by a farm in Tanba, homemade fresh pasta and seasonal ingredients; a terrace where dogs are welcome. Reviewers in 2026 describe an in-house cheese workshop with a shop, attentive staff, and many international guests at breakfast.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh cheese made every morning (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh ricotta and burrata; cheese breakfast.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor booked the 7 am breakfast as a non-guest and found only about two other Japanese groups among the overseas hotel guests — and a buffet heavy with cheeses and desserts.
A September 2026 diner could not catch all of the soft-spoken explanation of the sparkling wine over the chatter of other tables.
An October 2026 mother came with two daughters and the dog for the terrace, and the staff accommodated a last-minute time change.

kyoto_sou_nishihorin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-centred cooking with fish, crab, hamo and chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

kyoto_sou_nishihorin.notes: [Izakaya · Nishihorin west of Shijo Karasuma, dashi and cream croquettes] A lively izakaya a short walk west of Shijo Karasuma where ryotei-trained cooks build creative dishes on careful dashi: a three-bite starter, sashimi, shirako ponzu, fried taro, the house crab cream croquette and kamameshi, with regional sake. Half portions for solo diners; courses for groups. Busy with visitors from abroad early in the evening, calmer after 8. One August 2026 guest was charged for a wrong item — check the bill. ¥600 otoshi. Open until midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: skilled chefs who worked in traditional ryotei, combined with modern equipment such as vacuum machines and steam-convection ovens, cook dashi-centred creative Japanese food from seasonal ingredients; loved by locals and tourists. chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic, dashi-focused cooking in a casual, welcoming room (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 solo diner chose a course and found the chef had worked hamo — not on the course — into several dishes.
"However, I was disappointed to find that there was an order mistake, and I was charged for the incorrect menu item." — August 2026, titled "I should have checked the receipt".
An October 2026 Monday visitor found more than half the room foreign tourists at 7 pm and a much calmer room by 8.

On Shijo-dori in Gion, a short walk from Yasaka Shrine; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_koishi_honten.notes: [Sweets · Gion near Yasaka Shrine, Kyoto candy and kakigori] A Kyoto candy maker on Shijo-dori where, a reviewer says, maiko buy candy here: the ground floor sells jars of kyō-ame — the namesake Gion Koishi mix, Uji matcha, seasonal flavours — and the tea room behind and upstairs serves fluffy kakigori (Uji kintoki, melon, Amaou strawberry milk with anmitsu hidden inside, ¥1,270–1,630), a matcha parfait with free hojicha and warabi mochi. Short waits in the afternoon. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Kyoto candy (kyō-ame) house, whose namesake Gion Koishi mix has been its signature since the founding; its Gion main shop also has a tea room, and its hojicha candy uses the Kyoto hojicha served there. Per Tabelog: the ground floor is a candy shop and the upper floor a tea room (also listed as 茶房こいし). A reviewer says maiko from Gion come here to buy candy and that the shop avoids additives (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out natural flavour and sweetness without additives (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor called it the best kakigori of a lifetime — Uji kintoki — on a scorching day after visiting family graves at Gojozaka.
An October 2026 theatre-goer, before Kabuki at Minami-za, was glad to find kakigori still served after its supposed end in September.
"This is a shop where maiko from Gion come to buy candy." — August 2026.

kyoto_ippin_sakai.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses with dashi and soy, tempura and somen (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_ippin_sakai.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses built on dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippin_sakai.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00 (enter by 13:00) and dinner from 18:00 (enter by 20:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Lunch is cash only — no cards at lunch (Tabelog). Service in Japanese only (Tabelog). Lunch omakase ¥3,300 (7 dishes), with dearer lunch courses around ¥4,600; dinner omakase about ¥6,500 (Tabelog; June–October 2026). 19 seats: 8 at the counter and a semi-private sunken-kotatsu room for up to 12 (Tabelog). Free Wi-Fi (February 2026). On Takoyakushi west of Takakura; 4 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ippin_sakai.notes: [Kappo · Karasuma, a one-man kitchen at lunch prices] A hidden kappo near Karasuma where the owner cooks every dish alone, yet serves a seven-dish seasonal lunch for ¥3,300 — sashimi, hot tempura, conger eel, clay-pot rice — and a ¥6,500 dinner omakase. Counter or a sunken-kotatsu room; Japanese-only service; cash at lunch. One July 2026 diner flagged housekeeping (a sticky floor, clutter in view). Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), cooking every dish alone (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe the owner preparing every dish single-handed, still stopping to explain dishes in the private room (July and November 2026), and a gentle, attentive manner (June and August 2026). The shop text pitches seasonal Kyoto flavours at reasonable prices, suited to memorial gatherings and longevity celebrations (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "Enjoying the moment through interaction, not just flavor."

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner liked the food but listed housekeeping lapses: cardboard by the entrance, a sticky floor, and papers and notebooks piled in view of guests.
A July 2026 diner celebrating a husband’s birthday had been brought here by a mother for a birthday years before.
An October 2026 regular used Tabelog points for the ¥4,600 course with the year’s first matsutake dobin-mushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区蛸薬師通高倉西入る泉正寺町323 松本ビル 101、烏丸駅から徒歩4分、昼 12:00〜 (13:00までに入店、カード不可)・夜 18:00〜 (20:00までに入店)、火曜休み、予約可、日本語のみの対応、昼のおまかせ3,300円 (7品)、19席 (カウンター8、掘りごたつの半個室)、2020年8月1日オープン、旬の京の味を手頃に。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年11月、英語): 店主が一人で全部作る、昼3,000円・4,600円、夜のおまかせ6,500円、鱧、松茸の土瓶蒸し、天ぷら、土鍋の新米、日本酒800円から、床がべたつくなど清掃が気になったという声 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese-only service (Tabelog); book a course; cash at lunch.

kyoto_kyokushikatsu_todoroki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushikatsu in a wheat batter, fried in shared oil (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyokushikatsu_todoroki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetable skewers share the fryer with meat and seafood, and seasonings include dashi soy (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyokushikatsu_todoroki.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); Sun 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥200 a person plus tax (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「お席チャージ料、お一人様200円+税頂いております。」). 11 seats: 7–8 at the counter and a sunken-kotatsu table for 4; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; July 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and some QR (Tabelog). Up the stairs on the second floor of a Gion building, easy to miss; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2025). Opened 11 December 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyokushikatsu_todoroki.notes: [Kushikatsu · Gion, sauce-free skewers till 3 a.m.] A small second-floor counter in Gion frying kushikatsu in a thin, light batter and seasoning each skewer so it needs no sauce — duck, beef tongue, swordfish, nama-fu, mizu-nasu. The ¥2,700 course of eight skewers and starters is a bargain for Gion; add horse sashimi or Ishikawa fish. ¥200 seat charge; smoking allowed. Open to 3:00 (midnight on Sunday).

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): kushikatsu in a delicate batter with house-made sauces, daily seafood from Ishikawa and sake from around Japan; opened 11 December 2022. Reviewers mention a youthful team, sometimes one staff member on alone (August 2025, July 2026).

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner found it still finding its direction, was put off seeing staff accept drinks from acquaintances while cooking, and might go elsewhere next time.
A July 2026 solo diner found one person serving six guests until a second arrived, and still ate eight skewers plus five more for under ¥5,000.
An August 2025 diner with a picky companion found the staff accommodating with the omakase.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 串揚げ・居酒屋、東山区祇園町北側347-26 ピッケルビル 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:00)、日 18:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、不定休、予約可、お席チャージ1人200円+税、11席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつのテーブル4名)、貸切20名まで、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー可、2022年12月11日オープン、繊細な衣の串カツ、自家製ソース、Ishikawa の魚、全国の日本酒、おまかせ串揚げ8本と前菜2,700円。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): ソースなしで食べる串カツ、牛タン、鴨、すき焼き、生麩、水茄子、馬刺し、祇園にしては安い、まだ方向性を模索中という声 (2025年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Take the omakase course or order skewers à la carte; ¥200 seat charge; smoking allowed.

kyoto_ichihana_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Courses with dashi and soy, tempura and a beef cutlet, finished with kamameshi (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_ichihana_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on dashi with fish and meat (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_ichihana_nijo.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday (Tabelog). Because of a staff shortage, lunch is by phone reservation only (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥880 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「先付け 880円」). Lunch: two kamameshi courses, with or without sashimi (September 2026); dinner courses from ¥7,700 (the basic Koka course, November 2024) or à la carte (December 2025, February 2026). 7 counter seats only (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Near Nijo Castle; 3 min from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 2 (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ichihana_nijo.notes: [Kamameshi kappo · Nijo Castle, seven seats and an iron pot] A seven-seat counter near Nijo Castle where the chef cooks alone and ends every meal with kamameshi — oyster, crab, octopus and young ginger — cooked to order with a crisp crust. Lunch is a kamameshi course (about ¥3,000–5,000, phone booking only); dinner is a course from ¥7,700 or à la carte with sake. ¥880 appetizer charge. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), cooking alone at the counter (November 2025)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 February 2015 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a friendly owner-chef who runs the counter alone and talks with guests while cooking (2024–26 reviews); a December 2025 reviewer calls it a Bib Gourmand restaurant.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner found the dishes slow to arrive but the care worth the wait.
A January 2025 same-day booker heard about the etiquette of doing business in Kyoto from the chef.
A November 2024 diner noted prices had been raised because of rising costs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・釜飯、中京区押小路油小路西入る二条油小路町264-1、二条城前駅2番出口から徒歩3分、昼 12:00〜14:00・夜 17:00〜21:00、水曜・日曜休み、人手不足のため昼は電話予約のみ、先付け880円、カウンター7席のみ、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2015年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 約7種の釜めし (蛸と新生姜、牡蠣、蟹、鶏ときのこ)、湯葉と雲丹、お造り、茶碗蒸し、鯛のあら炊き、天ぷら、牛カツ、夜のコース7,700円から、昼の釜めしコース、店主一人で切り盛り、ビブグルマンという声、料理が出るまで時間がかかるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (lunch phone only); counter of seven; ¥880 appetizer charge.

kyoto_saryo_tesshin.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is 100% buckwheat (October 2026), but the dipping sauces and broths use soy, and there is fried tofu and a financier (2026 reviews).
kyoto_saryo_tesshin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: broths are bonito or duck, and the signature Daigo soba has cheese and egg yolk (2026 reviews).
kyoto_saryo_tesshin.hours_raw: Japanese breakfast 8:00–11:00 (reservation by 21:00 the day before); lunch 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:15); dinner 17:00–21:00 (last entry 20:00; evening course by reservation the day before); Wednesday 10:00–16:00 only (Tabelog). Seating limited to 45 minutes; one drink per person; preschool children only in the 15:00 slot; same-day bookings by phone (Tabelog). No cash — cards, IC cards, e-money and QR only (Tabelog; September 2026). 13 counter seats, some beside a small garden; English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog; October 2026). Just south of Karasuma Marutamachi, 3 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 27 April 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_saryo_tesshin.notes: [Soba · Karasuma Marutamachi, luxury soba from 8 a.m.] A plush thirteen-seat soba counter south of the Imperial Palace, the Kyoto shop of a Miyazaki soba house, open from breakfast. Try the Daigo soba — 100% buckwheat under Parmigiano and egg yolk — or the duck nanban in a rich broth. Pricey at about ¥4,000–6,000, and two diners found the soba's aroma faint for the price. 45-minute seatings; one drink each; no cash.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 April 2024 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer calls it the Kyoto shop of a long-popular soba restaurant from Miyazaki City (Tabelog lists Soba ya Tesshin in Miyazaki), notes a painting of a tiger and cub by Shinsuke Kawahara, and a Tabelog review title cites a Michelin Bib Gourmand. The soba flour came from Azumino, a September 2026 diner was told.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found the soba’s aroma and sweetness barely there for ¥5,200 and the bowl too hot to hold, though the décor and service were striking.
An October 2026 diner liked the cheese aroma of the Daigo soba but felt it lacked buckwheat fragrance for the price.
An October 2026 visitor found the English menu and fluent English service thorough, and urged finishing with soba-yu.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff; book online; cashless only; 45-minute seatings.
